name: Emma O'Shea
bio: EmmaEdel O'Shea is an actress, known for The Lobster (2015) and Needles (2010).

credits.title: The Lobster
credits.overview: In a dystopian near future, single people, according to the laws of The City, are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in forty-five days or are transformed into animals and sent off into The Woods.
